LESSON: JESUS

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Early life
Topic 3.2: Jesus

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Jesus. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate work by emulating parents at home

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. appreciate work by emulating parents at home
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate work by emulating parents at home. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Jesus.
2. Explain Jesus to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: The learners to read Matthew 8:23-27 1.
4. Show that you can: appreciate work by emulating parents at home
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Jesus. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Jesus important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. The learners to read Matthew 8:23-27 1.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. appreciate work by emulating parents at home

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
